experiment_data.hypothesis: Retrain Vanilla (no auxiliary head) seed 42 to restore the missing baseline checkpoint needed for gradient-level mechanism analysis. Same config as original mvp_vanilla_s0: OpenVLA-OFT, LoRA rank 32, 50K steps, no occ/depth head.
